linkedin:
Astro Static vs Server: Which One Are You Actually Deploying?

Your `astro.config.mjs` `output` value decides the deploy. `output: 'static'` (the default) builds a `dist/` folder of files you host on object storage plus a CDN, cheap and serverless. `output: 'server'` (with an adapter like `@astrojs/node`) builds a Node app you run as a live process on a server.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/deploy-astro-app/
